description: This PHP class 'EmployeeLanguage' extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable' to filter employee language records in reports. It includes methods for modifying query builders based on language filters and converting language IDs to human-readable arrays.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: A class for filtering employee language data in reports, allowing filtering by language ID and normalizing language values.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filtering condition to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and a language ID (X) is specified.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias for use in query joins, here 'language'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the language ID (X) into an array with id and label for display, fetching details via LanguageService.
